title: The timeline_view link-closure debt records the editor data plane it reaches through view-core

installed_sdk.rationale: No timeline, editor or playback header, target or symbol changes. pulp-view-core now links the UI-free pulp-dataplane module (value sources, value channels, host parameter surfaces), so the timeline_view closure names one more module whose code was previously compiled inside pulp-view-core.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command gains, loses or changes behaviour.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added or altered.

live_product_control.rationale: A link-closure debt entry creates no product capability, grant or policy projection.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The change describes no authoring capability; it records a module the existing view-core link already reaches, without widening the timeline_view include floor.
